description: List durable house projects owned by the calling API key, most recently updated first. Anonymous (keyless) calls always return an empty list -- temporary anonymous projects are never listable, only resolvable directly by their house_ref. Requires an API key.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor -- pass the previous response's next_cursor to get the next page.

include_deleted.description: Include soft-deleted projects (still owner-scoped). Default false.

limit.description: Max projects to return, default 50, capped at 200.

project_type.description: Filter by project type, e.g. 'house'. Omit for all types.

updated_since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp -- only return projects updated after this time.

name: project_list
title: List Your Durable Projects
